proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  have tail : ∀ k : ℕ, (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p).real (Set.Ici k) = (1 - (p : ℝ)) ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      have : Set.Ici (0 : ℕ) = Set.univ := by ext; simp
      rw [this]; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      have hu : Set.Ici k = {k} ∪ Set.Ici (k + 1) := by
        ext n; simp only [Set.mem_Ici, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; omega
      have hd : Disjoint ({k} : Set ℕ) (Set.Ici (k + 1)) := by
        rw [Set.disjoint_singleton_left]; simp
      have := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union (μ := ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) hd measurableSet_Ici
      rw [← hu, ih, ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure_real_singleton hp] at this
      rw [pow_succ]
      linarith
  refine ⟨tail, fun hp1 m n => ?_⟩
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - (p : ℝ) := by
    have : (p : ℝ) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne p.2.2 (fun h => hp1 (Subtype.ext h))
    linarith
  have hinter : Set.Ici m ∩ Set.Ici (m + n) = Set.Ici (m + n) := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Ici]; omega
  rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, ProbabilityTheory.cond_apply measurableSet_Ici, hinter, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ← MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, ← MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, tail, tail, tail, pow_add]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (p : unitInterval), p ≠ 0 → (∀ k : ℕ, (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p).real (Set.Ici k) = (1 - (p : ℝ)) ^ k) ∧ (p ≠ 1 → ∀ m n : ℕ, (ProbabilityTheory.cond (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) (Set.Ici m)).real (Set.Ici (m + n)) = (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p).real (Set.Ici n))
